text: The legal issues in the paragraph involve the enforceability of a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) where the individual, Alex, claims they were not aware of the restrictions and that the document was not signed in the presence of a witness. The specific case questions presented are whether the lack of a witness during signing affects the validity of the NDA, whether Alex's lack of awareness of the restrictions constitutes a valid defense against the termination, and whether the termination itself was lawful given these potential defects in the agreement.
